# The custom-header regression test checks in-dialog insertion

The test reaches the real Custom Headers dialog through the filter editor, types X-Foo, clicks Add, waits for a row and checks the count and name. It closes the window without accepting it. These assertions cover in-dialog insertion after the async guard repair; they do not establish saved preferences, duplicate handling, overflow limits or a filter match.

Scope: Message-filter custom-header browser test.
